## Core 4x4 Analytics Pipeline

A local Windows data application that converts marketplace and internal CSV exports into a standardized, traceable event ledger. The workflow supports validation reporting, approved SKU mapping, duplicate handling, optional SQL Server loading, and Power BI analytics views.

::: {.tag-list}
<span>Python</span><span>Flask</span><span>SQL Server</span><span>Power BI</span><span>Data Validation</span>
:::

## CedHealth

A Flask-based health application for managing accounts, goals, meals, workouts, weight entries, favorites, and nutrition-oriented analysis. It uses SQLite persistence, Jinja templates, and progressive-web-app support.

::: {.tag-list}
<span>Python</span><span>Flask</span><span>SQLite</span><span>Jinja</span><span>PWA</span>
:::

## TowerDefend

A browser-based tower-defense game built around a TypeScript game loop. The project includes wave progression, upgrades, achievements, persistent player state, responsive controls, and an installable offline-capable PWA shell.

::: {.tag-list}
<span>TypeScript</span><span>React</span><span>Vite</span><span>Tailwind CSS</span><span>PWA</span>
:::
